description: This file implements React components for a chat list interface, including individual chat items with drag-and-drop reordering, utilizing external libraries for icons, styling, and routing. It manages chat sessions state, UI interactions, and rendering logic.

methods.name: ChatItem
methods.description: A React component representing a single chat session item, with drag-and-drop capability and delete functionality.

methods.name: ChatList
methods.description: A React component rendering a list of chat sessions with drag-and-drop reordering, selection, and deletion features.
